entries.description: Conducting observational astrophysics research under faculty supervision, with a focus on photometric variability of stellar objects. Developed Python pipelines for automated data reduction and source extraction from ground-based telescope observations.
highlights: Reduced and analyzed multi-band photometric data from ground-based telescope observations
Developed Python pipelines for automated data reduction and source extraction
Contributed to ongoing characterization of variable stellar populations

entries.description: Supported development and testing of optical sensor hardware for scientific instruments. Designed analog signal conditioning circuits and wrote firmware for embedded sensor readout in C.
highlights: Designed and tested analog signal conditioning circuits
Wrote firmware for embedded sensor readout in C
Documented test procedures and calibration results
